description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340004773905 COVER,ACCESS: Line 0001 Qty 22 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0155 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 3. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 0HM72 SS7000-6A; 2B834 SS7000-6A; 54878 SS7000-6A; 59213 SS7000-6A; 78286 SS7000-6A; 9E232 SS7000-6A. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
